title: The Legendary Hero Is Dead!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: As the Demon King's seal at Hell's Gate weakens, the hero Sion returns to battle but dies in a pit trap dug by perverted farmer Touka Scott. To cover it up, the necromancer Anri places Touka's soul in Sion's corpse, and Touka, his childhood friend Yuna and Anri set out to seal the Gates of Hell. Played as a parody harem fantasy, the story later reveals darker material, including that Sion's death was a suicide after trauma (Wikipedia; Shogakukan blurb; AniList Parody).
life_message: Even an unlikely, selfish person can grow into a real hero by taking up a burden others left behind.

content.note: Battles with demons and undead, war at Hell's Gate, a scientist making skeleton armies from people (Wikipedia; AniList War, Zombie; MU Monster/s, Magical Battles).
Undead and necromancy; tragic reveals (AniList Tragedy spoiler tag).

Touka is a pervert whose antics drive ecchi gags; nudity, fetish and exhibitionism humor; harem rivalry (Wikipedia 'perverted soul'; AniList Nudity, Female Harem; MU Perverted Male Lead, Exhibitionism, Fetish/es; MangaDex suggestive).
Sion's death revealed as suicide after massive trauma (Wikipedia; AniList Tragedy; MU Dead Protagonist).
Hiding a killing, lechery and pranks played as comedy (Shogakukan blurb; MU Sly Male Lead).
